nodes.ogien.text.t: A halt by a stream. Skarimir pokes the embers with a stick and reels off jokes, Ragnosława sharpens her spear and looks at nobody, and Wojmir sits so close to the fire his foot-wraps are smoking. Nobody mentions where you're headed. Best not to call the wolf by name.

nodes.ragnoslawa.text.t: "I asked the master why four, and why us," Ragnosława mutters, not stopping her sharpening. "He grunted that orders aren't for thinking about. What do you think?"

nodes.ragnoslawa_posluch.text.t: Ragnosława nods, though she looks like she's choked on a fishbone. "You're probably right. Doesn't make me feel any better, though."

nodes.ragnoslawa_sprawdz.text.t: Ragnosława gives a crooked smile, her first since morning. "I'll remember you said that. Might come in handy someday."

nodes.skarimir.text.t: "Know what I'd do with the imperial tribute? Eat it! The roast first, then the little scribe, and the courier for afters!" Wojmir goes pale, and Skarimir roars with laughter till he spits on the fire. "Like they say: don't praise the day before… before supper!" "Before sunset, you muttonhead," Ragnosława mutters. "And when's supper, then?"

nodes.skarimir_cicho.text.t: Skarimir raises his paws as if surrendering. "All right, all right, I'll shut up. But if we sit here with sour faces all the way, we'll be dead of it before we get there."

nodes.skarimir_smiech.text.t: "Ha! We'll make a man of you yet!" He tosses a stick onto the fire. "If they eat us, at least they'll enjoy it."

nodes.wojmir.text.t: Wojmir shifts over a hand's breadth to make room for you. "I… I'm not like them. I can't lift a spear, I can't tell jokes. All I can do is write." He stares into the embers. "I'm afraid that's not enough."

nodes.wojmir_cieplo.text.t: Wojmir takes the piece of bread as if he'd been handed treasure. "God repay you. If I can ever pay you back, I'll… well, I'll write you a verse." He laughs nervously, and for the first time his shoulders drop.

nodes.wojmir_milczenie.text.t: You sit side by side and say nothing. After a while Wojmir falls asleep sitting up, pen in his fist.
